target: Satellite DHW at issue date+h, degree C-weeks
selection: Minimum pooled validation MAE, refit AI through 2019, calibration fixed to 2020-2021, no test tuning.
baselines: HotSpot persistence with outgoing 84-day window accounting
calibration: Per-site absolute residual 90th split-conformal rank with finite-sample correction; no coverage guarantee under time dependence.
uncertainty: Descriptive paired 90-day calendar-block bootstrap, all sites kept together, 1000 resamples, seed42.
model_selection_guardrail: Never use 2022-2025 test or 2026 replay to select models, features, hyperparameters or calibration.
pretraining_quality_gate: All four inputs must be valid for 84 continuous days; no interpolation; this gate was clarified before any evaluation run.
hash_scope: Model pipeline and its scientific tests only; application UI may evolve independently.
pretraining_documentation_update: Reproduction command includes full pytest API integration suite; final artifact and source hashes will be public in evaluation.json.

pre_evaluation_integrity_patch.reason: Verify model artifact SHA-256 against evaluation.json before local joblib deserialization; no change to training, features, candidates, splits, hyperparameters or calibration. No performance results existed at patch time.

pre_evaluation_physics_patch.reason: Prevent an arbitrarily negative learned residual from erasing heat stress that remains inside the future 84-day window. No complete evaluation or model training output existed at patch time.
pre_evaluation_physics_patch.assumption: Nearest-0.01 DHW/HotSpot quantization; ERDDAP metadata are unpacked floats without scale_factor or rounding-policy guarantee. This is an explicitly conditional plausibility floor, not complete physical conservation.
pre_evaluation_physics_patch.fixed_scope: Apply to every residual AI candidate at validation and to final evaluation/inference; leave candidate regressors, features, training targets, hyperparameters, splits, baselines and interval formula unchanged.
pre_evaluation_physics_patch.test_data_usage: No test/2026 performance or residuals used to choose the formula or tolerance.

pre_evaluation_output_precision_patch.reason: Preserve floating-point forecast values for independent exact event/coverage recomputation; write predictions with 17 significant digits instead of 6 decimal places. No numerical modeling changes.
